edits.newText:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { OrderReceipt } from '#shared/types/order'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { $fetch, definePageMeta, navigateTo } from '#imports'
import UiBadge from '#layers/ui/app/components/UiBadge.vue'
import UiButton from '#layers/ui/app/components/UiButton.vue'
import FormInput from '#layers/ui/app/components/form/Input.vue'
import CartSummary from '~/components/cart/Summary.vue'
import { useCart } from '~/composables/useCart'
import { useDiscount } from '~/composables/useDiscount'
import { useProducts } from '~/composables/useProducts'

definePageMeta({ middleware: 'cart-not-empty' })

await useProducts()
const email = ref('')
const { lines } = useCart()
const { code } = useDiscount()

async function placeOrder() {
  const order = await $fetch<OrderReceipt>('/api/orders', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: {
      lines: lines.value,
      code: code.value ?? undefined,
    },
  })
  lines.value = []
  await navigateTo(`/orders/${order.id}`)
}
</script>
